Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Controls SME is Managed Services' controls and automation expert, embedded in a data center build. The role supports design review, vendor oversight, and commissioning to make sure the control systems are operable, maintainable, and trustworthy at turnover. Controls are the facility's nervous system: when they fail or mislead, operators lose sight of everything else.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Operability Design Review
Review controls designs, including BMS/BAS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC-based plant controls, CDU and cooling plant controls, and generator, UPS, and switchgear controller integration, through an operations lens. Sequences of operations, failure-mode and fail-safe behavior, loss-of-network and loss-of-controller response, manual and local override, point lists and instrumentation adequacy, alarm philosophy and prioritization, graphics clarity, and OT network architecture and access control. Push back where the design assumes an operator will understand or recover something the system never tells them.


Controls QA/QC and Vendor Oversight
Provide QA/QC oversight of controls scope for new construction and retrofits: review vendor proposals and programming, directly oversee system configuration and component upgrades, and witness factory tests. Hold controls vendors to Hut 8 standards and to the approved sequences, and make sure every modification to a system follows change control.


Construction-Phase Verification
Walk controls installations at key milestones. Flag operability and quality issues to the MEP superintendent early, while they are still cheap to fix.


Commissioning
Witness Level 3-5 commissioning of controls and automation: point-to-point verification, sequence- of-operations testing, controller, server, and network failover, alarm verification, trend validation, and integrated systems testing across mechanical, electrical, and controls, including loss-of- communication and loss-of-BMS scenarios. Review programming through the commissioning process, drive operational findings into the Cx log with clear acceptance criteria, and verify closure personally.


Turnover Readiness
Verify controls turnover packages: as-built sequences of operation, point lists, control and network drawings, programming backups and configuration files under version control, licenses and credentials transferred to Hut 8, alarm setpoint and priority matrices, trend baselines, spare controllers and critical modules, and PM program inputs such as backup routines, firmware updates, and panel power health. Confirm the backups actually restore.


Training
Provide technical controls training and support to Facility Operations staff, and validate that operator training equips the team to use the systems, not just look at them.


Program Feedback
Feed operational lessons into Hut 8 controls standards, point naming and alarm conventions, and the next project's basis of design, and work with other Hut 8 sites and teams to carry standards across the portfolio.

ABOUT YOU
What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of controls experience in programming, start-up, and commissioning of complex systems such as central plants, air handling units, and evaporative cooling and humidification systems. A bachelor's degree or trade certification in a related field plus 3+ years of controls industry experience will be considered in lieu.
  • Experience in critical environments, with a working knowledge of critical facility operations and procedure-based work.
  • Theoretical and practical understanding of control equipment and systems: design, maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, and construction.
  • Working knowledge of the mechanical, electrical, and life safety systems found in critical facilities.
  • Sequence-of-operations fluency: you can read one critically, catch the gaps and failure modes, and test whether it behaves as written.
  • Experience interpreting blueprints, CAD drawings, and controls diagrams.
  • Turnover documentation rigor, especially programming backups, configuration files, and version control.
  • Comfortable embedded with a construction team while holding the operations line, and effective in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred:

  • Data center experience.
  • PLC programming experience
  • IT or networking certification
  • Equipment field service engineering or manufacturer representative experience.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve workflows with measurable results, such as efficiency gains or quality improvements.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Full time on-site role.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

We are seeking

We are seeking a Principal Construction Manager to lead the delivery of Bitdeer’s large-scale AI data center programs. You will be Bitdeer’s senior construction authority for your assigned programs, accountable for safety, schedule, quality, and cost across one or more sites and phases, from preconstruction and mobilization through energization, commissioning, and turnover.

You will set the construction strategy, direct general contractors and trade partners, guide site construction managers and discipline leads, and represent construction to executive leadership. The ideal candidate has delivered multiple large-scale data center or mission-critical programs from the owner’s or general contractor’s side and can set standards that scale across Bitdeer’s portfolio.

What you will be responsible for

Program Leadership

  • Program Ownership: Act as Bitdeer’s senior construction lead and single point of accountability for assigned data center programs across one or more sites and phases.
  • Construction Strategy: Set the delivery approach, phasing, and contracting strategy with leadership, design, and procurement.
  • Team Leadership: Guide and mentor site construction leads, superintendents, and discipline leads, and set clear priorities across sites.

Schedule, Cost & Commercial

  • Contract & Change Management: Lead negotiation of contractor scopes, change orders, and claims with procurement and legal.

Safety, Quality & Risk

  • Preconstruction Input: Lead constructability and design reviews to improve cost, schedule, and buildability.
  • Lessons Learned: Capture lessons learned and apply them to future sites and phases.

How you will stand out

  • Experience: 15+ years in construction management, including 8+ years leading data center or mission-critical construction.
  • Program Scale: Delivered multiple large-scale, fast-track data center projects end to end, including multi-phase campus or multi-site programs with budgets of $100M+.

  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree or MBA.
  • Certifications: Professional certifications such as PMP, CCM, or OSHA 30-Hour.
  • High-Density Facilities: Experience delivering high-density AI or HPC facilities, including liquid cooling.
  • Travel & Site Presence: Willingness to travel regularly across active project sites and to be on site during critical phases.

  • Executive Communication: Communicates clearly and credibly with executives, partners, and field teams.
  • Influence: Builds alignment across design, procurement, operations, and contractors.

Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

The Role

The Credit and Lending team is responsible for the predictive intelligence that underpins Block’s primary capital-intensive products. These products unlock unique access to credit for our customers, many of whom are otherwise underbanked and underserved by the traditional financial system. As a member of the Credit Policy team within Square Financial Services (SFS), you will occupy a high-leverage role at the intersection of regulated banking and advanced autonomous systems. This position requires end-to-end ownership of credit policy, from the evaluation of novel data signals to the design of the decisioning logic that drives Block’s top-line growth. Beyond policy design, this role carries core responsibility for credit policy governance: ensuring that policy changes and experiments are rigorously designed, reviewed, documented, monitored, and reported in line with the expectations of a regulated bank.

Our credit products are material drivers of the company’s profitability and are frequently highlighted in executive reviews and quarterly earnings reports. We are seeking a scientifically-minded contributor capable of delivering extraordinary individual leverage to expand our underwriting capabilities into previously untapped segments through pragmatic policy evolution and advanced modeling techniques.

  • Apply a rigorous scientific mindset to the challenge of underwriting new customer segments, involving the evaluation of alternative external data sources and the design of new policy strategies to expand access while protecting the portfolio.
  • Own credit policy governance and reporting: maintain policy documentation, change logs, and approval artifacts, and deliver recurring portfolio performance and policy-impact reporting to credit risk committees, senior leadership, and bank oversight functions.
  • Propose and design experiments for credit products — champion/challenger tests, randomized holdouts, and staged rollouts across approval, limit, and pricing strategy — with clear hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, and loss-exposure budgets.
  • Review experiment designs proposed by partner teams, assessing statistical rigor, sample sizing, risk exposure, fair lending considerations, and alignment with credit policy and regulatory requirements before launch.
  • Form policy guidelines and frameworks — risk appetite thresholds, approval and limit standards, and concentration limits — that enable credit portfolios to scale responsibly while meeting growth, loss, and profitability objectives.

  • Strong quantitative intuition and data visualization skills, with a proven ability to conduct sophisticated ad-hoc and exploratory analysis.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

Product Partnership

Staff Product Security Engineer

United States, remote first with NY office available · Full-time · Security · Reports to CISO

About DFNS

Finance is moving onchain. Stablecoins, tokenized deposits, securities and funds are changing how money and assets are issued, held and transferred. The destination is a financial system where any asset can be issued, moved and governed onchain with the controls regulated institutions require. That shift needs a new foundation. Just as core banking systems manage accounts and ledgers today, financial institutions need a platform to manage digital assets. DFNS is that platform. Today, we secure hundreds of billions of dollars in assets every month for more than 500 clients worldwide.

Why this role

Our platform secures a lot of value. Every code path, dependency and deployment is a potential route to that value. The record we are protecting is zero breaches. You will own the security of the product itself, from threat models and architecture reviews to the secure development lifecycle, pentests, bug bounty and incident response. In year one you will put automated security gates into CI/CD, threat model the signing path and the governance model end to end and become the engineer our clients’ security teams want in the room during due diligence.

What you’ll do

  • Own product security across the platform, from threat modeling and design reviews to code review and dynamic testing.

  • Build the secure development lifecycle into CI/CD, with SAST and DAST, dependency and supply chain controls (SBOM, signing, provenance) and secrets scanning running as automated gates.

  • Lead vulnerability management for the product, from triage and prioritization to fix verification and security releases, with Engineering.

  • Run the external pentest program and the bug bounty, and work directly with researchers.

  • Lead incident response for product security events, from detection and containment to forensics, post-mortems and the controls that follow.

  • Represent our security in client due diligence and audits, from security questionnaires and pentest reports to architecture sessions with bank security teams.

  • Raise the bar for every engineer through secure coding guidance, training and reusable security patterns and libraries.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • Hands-on application security on production systems that handle money or sensitive data, including threat modeling, code review and finding and fixing real vulnerabilities.

  • Ability to read and write TypeScript and Rust (or Go) well enough to review and fix security issues yourself.

  • Experience building security into CI/CD, including SAST and DAST, dependency and supply chain controls and secrets management.

  • Applied cryptography fluency. You know how keys, signatures, TLS and PKI get misused in practice and you can review an MPC or HSM integration without designing the protocol yourself.

  • Cloud security on AWS, including IAM, networking and KMS or Nitro Enclaves.

  • Experience running pentests or a bug bounty and leading incident response.

  • Communication that works with engineers and with external security teams such as bank CISOs and auditors.

Nice-to-haves

  • Smart contract security on EVM or Solana.

  • Experience with MPC or threshold signature systems, or with HSMs.

  • Published research, CVEs or conference talks.

  • Experience producing SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence for secure development controls.

How we work

We are a distributed company headquartered in Paris. Our teams work from Europe, the US and Asia, with offices in New York, Geneva, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong and São Paulo. We write decisions down so they survive time zones. We hold our own work to the standards our clients are held to. We hire people who can own an outcome end to end and we give them the room to do it.

What we offer

A competitive base salary set by role and location, a bonus or variable plan where the role carries one and stock options vesting over four years. Healthcare, flexible vacation, parental leave and a one-time home technology allowance, with travel expenses covered. A MacBook and the equipment you need to do your best work. Remote first, with an office if you want one.

Base salary range: $150,000-250,000

Hiring process

We aim to complete the process in 2 weeks and we tell you where you stand after every step.

  • Intro call with Co-CEO (30 minutes).

  • Personality and cognitive assessments, completed on your own time (45 minutes).

  • A technical take-home exercise

  • Focus Interviews (about 3 hours): CISO (30 minutes), technical exercise (45 minutes), general security (45 minutes), design security (45 minutes) and culture fit (30 minutes).

  • Reference calls and background checks.

Equal opportunity

DFNS is an equal opportunity employer and considers every applicant based on ability and potential, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or any other characteristic protected by law.
